spans.text: At the New York Public Library.
Not long after M870's clash with Springfield...
Tell me the truth about something.
There is no Santa Claus. It was your parents all along.
Ehhhhh? Do you have parents, 416?!
...C'mon, I'm being serious.
That's a dangerous word to use, 416.
Don't forget we're playing a game now.
Didn't you say you were serious about winning the prize?
Well, I'm not saying I'm going to step aside and let other people have the prize either.
But don't go lumping two completely different matters together.
So, what were you going to ask?
I've just been wondering, do you actually have a concrete plan?
We aren't on the battlefield, 416.
We know nothing about the setting of this game, or have you been to America before?
We see the situation and respond appropriately, we adapt to all challenges and overcome them. That's our specialty, isn't it?
Is that why you were lying prone in a grass patch laughing at Squad M870 like a lunatic for almost 20 minutes?
But they WERE funny, weren't they? At times like these you should just go along and laugh with me.
Oh, there's no need to put on that constipated face of yours. Who are you trying to impress, anyway?
I have no idea what you're talking about. It doesn't seem the least bit funny.
Either you're very out of touch with your feelings or you're a really good actress.
In any case, I really HAVE seen everything now.
That lot from Griffin are really good at springing surprises on you.
Haha, it's true, and that M870 Doll is quite amusing.
She's just chewing up the scenery.
...Springfield's taken good care of us every time we stopped over in Griffin.
Don't take it too far.
Ja, ja, I know, our Lady 416 is chivalrous to a fault.
Is this how noble Dolls are different from us?
ELITE Dolls.
I've never heard of "noble Dolls" before.
Alright, I get it.
While there's no way she'd remember us, it's true that she's done us a few good turns in the past.
And as you know, I always return others' favors.
So, wouldn't it be kind of us to spare them the ruthlessness of this game by ousting them?
Aren't you blowing things out of proportion?
Neither of them took any losses, did they?
I mean, just look at Squad M870 and Squad Springfield.
All because 416 did something unnecessary, don't you think?
What does that have to do with me? If I hadn't launched the flashbang, their conflict wouldn't have intensified, would it?
Everything went your way in the end, right?
That's true. Oh my, I suppose it all comes down to Springfield's saintly nature.
So now what?
What do you plan to do next?
Given Springfield's personality, pitting her against other teams would be pointless.
Now, M870, on the other hand, makes an excellent target.
Even if it's just for the sake of the prize money, we need to eliminate our weaker opponents first.
So you're saying we're going to give up on Squad Springfield and guide M870 and her sidekicks instead?
Exactly. That'll also be less risky for us.
When you compare the two, idiots are easier to manipulate, don't you think?
...No comment.
Now, the first thing we have to do is take care of the Griffin HQ Squad~♪
They're kind of an eyesore, considering how they're in the way of my prize.
Understood~
9 chuckles as she picks up a rock...
A rock comes flying at M870 out of nowhere. Fortunately, she ducks in time, and no harm is done.
Who did that? Who has the balls to assault an officer in broad daylight?!
You, that Doll over there! Was it you?
Yes, you, the one with the silver hair! Hold it right there!
Huh, now that was a good throw.
Hehe, I've had practice, you know.
How is it, how is it? Are they fighting yet?
9 creeps forward to take a look, but 45 shoves her back.
Dummkopf, they'll spot you.
In any case, they've made contact, but I wouldn't get your hopes up.
416 is right - out of the three people in the distance, M870 is the only agitated one. Meanwhile, VSK-94 and Vector both seem very composed.
Looks like both of them are the calm type.
I guess you can't count on them to start fights easily, no?
After all, there was no proof that Vector threw the stone.
She has no legitimate reason to attack Vector.
Tsk tsk... How naïve.
You think people won't attack each other without a proper reason?
If the world were actually so reasonable, there'd be no more wars.
Please, not everyone is as rotten as you.
Still, sounds to me she's just a bit too into her character as a police officer, don't you think?
It's role-play gone mad.
In the end, her own characterization tripped her up.
So you need to charge someone with a crime if you want to do anything to them? How dumb is that.
What now? Looks like they aren't going to fight.
Are we really going to let them go just like that?
Oh, Vector's leaving.
Tsk. Come on, try harder!
M870 suddenly calls out to Vector as the latter is about to leave. However, judging by the dubious looks in VSK-94 and Vector's eyes, she doesn't seem to have figured out what she wants to say yet.
I didn't expect her to be so useless.
Should we just fire a shot their way?
Nah, that would be too obvious.
...Hang on, look at M870.
Hm?
You are guilty of —
ILLEGAL POSSESSION OF FIREARMS!!!
PUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!!!!
...This is gross. She's laughing her ass off but she isn't making a sound.
Look at her, she's writhing around like a maggot.
Well, we'd be spotted if she actually laughed out loud.
Fortunately this game has a team channel.
Hah... Oh these Griffin Dolls, are they trying to make me laugh to death and then steal my savings?
Illegal possession of firearms... What kind of neural cloud does she have to come up with a joke like that?
She could be making more money as a stand-up comedian than wasting time grubbing for money with us.
Whoa...
What is it, what is it? Did something even funnier happen?
Let me see!
Well...
M870 and VSK-94 are fighting each other.
Pffft...ahahahahahaha!!
Oh those two, they really are trying to make me laugh to death, aren't they?
...Granted, this whole situation really is quite ridiculous. But if you keep laughing like this, the screws are going to fall out of that patchwork body of yours.
I can't stand this anymore... 9, give me a hand, hahaha...
It's a shame Gr G11 can't see this, I need to tell her all about it once we're back.
Looks like Vector's at a loss too... So what now?
In the end, you didn't cause her any trouble at all, did you?
That's fine. It's good enough that we got rid of those two clowns.
Also... As I recall, there are four people on Squad Vector, right? Where are the other two?
I think it was Vector's tactical decision as team leader.
They must have split up, with R93 and K5 going the other way.
Huh...they're splitting their forces even in these dangerous conditions.
Looks like they're pretty confident.
Vector is one of the few elites in Griffin.
She may look as dull as dishwater, but she's extremely stubborn.
What, since when did you become a Griffin Encyclopedia?
Or are you one of her fans?
I won't dignify that with a reply.
Humph... Very stubborn indeed.
Then we'll give her a taste of the cruelty of this world.
Since the ideal conditions have arisen, it would be a shame not to make use of them.
Taking them out one by one, hm? I love it when 45 is being despicable.
Who's despicable?
Stop strangling your teammate.
So, who's first?
R93, of course.
You said it, didn't you? Vector is one of the few elites in Griffin.
I don't plan to take on tasks I know to be difficult.
45 starts humming cheerfully to herself as she turns to head the other way.
Humph...
She said she was only in it for the money...
But in the end she's the most hardcore when it comes to playing the game...
Seriously...
What's the fun in camping like this...
